  In response to Councilmember Lyon's inquiry regarding housing in
  mixed-use areas, Susan Ambrosini, urban planning consultant from
  AECOM, reported that there is flexibility in most mixed-use areas,
  however, portions of Colorado require a commercial space on the
  ground floor to preserve the existing character of the area. Planning
  Director Paige also added that feedback from public engagement
  and the Planning Commission expressed support for including some
  housing opportunities to the area, while still maintaining creative and
  commercial spaces.
